caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a cape or short cloak. The cape is predominantly brown in color and features detailed embroidery in a slightly lighter brown shade, forming floral and leafy patterns on the front and along the edges. The garment has a rounded collar that is fastened at the neck with a wide, matching brown ribbon tied in a bow. The edges of the cape are finished with a thin border of a darker purple or burgundy color, and the interior lining visible at the hem appears to be of a similar reddish shade. The overall composition is centered on the solitary garment, presented against a plain, neutral-beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Cape
